newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady ahead of PPI.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady ahead of PPI.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady on Friday in moderate trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. June producer price index (PPI), dealers said.
The producer price index for June is forecast to be unchanged from a 0.3 percent fall reported in May.

"Rates were quite steady in the morning except for some position adjustments. Some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's PPI figures and the outcome of the (Singapore) Budget later today," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact as the numbers have been built into the market and most people have squared their positions for the weekend," he said.
In day-to-day rates, weekend eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, Monday/Tuesday was unchanged from Thursday's 5-9/16 5-7/16 and week-fixed eased 1/16 point to 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8, nine-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
